question:
You have the following code:

x = 3
y = 5
if x < 4:
    if y > 4:
        print("Nested condition met")

What will be the output?

choices.A: No output, because the outer condition is False
choices.B: No output, because the inner condition is False
choices.C: It will print "Nested condition met" once
choices.D: It will raise a SyntaxError due to spacing
